# Zero breaches is a smell

`customer_support.heu.sla_management.zero_breaches_is_a_smell` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> A queue that has never breached is not evidence of excellence.


## The heuristic

**A queue that has never breached is not evidence of excellence.**


_Why:_ Real service under real load misses sometimes. A spotless record almost always means the target was set below actual capability — in which case it is not constraining anything — or that clocks are being stopped rather than met.
